plan.title: Donations Summary for 2023
plan.subtitle: Overview of donation amounts, sources, and trends throughout the year

panels.title: Total donations received
panels.sql: SELECT SUM("Amount") AS total_amount FROM donor_transactions WHERE "Date" LIKE '2023%';

panels.title: Donations by payment mode
panels.sql: SELECT "Mode", SUM("Amount") AS total_amount FROM donor_transactions WHERE "Date" LIKE '2023%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

panels.title: Monthly donation trend
panels.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', "Date") AS month, SUM("Amount") AS total_amount FROM donor_transactions WHERE "Date" LIKE '2023%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Top 10 donors by total amount
panels.sql: SELECT "Donor", SUM("Amount") AS total_amount FROM donor_transactions WHERE "Date" LIKE '2023%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 10;

plan.narrative: The dashboard provides a concise overview of the organization's donation performance for the year 2023. The total amount of donations received is summarized in the first KPI panel, giving a clear figure for the annual report. The second panel breaks down these donations by payment mode, highlighting the most common methods used by supporters. The third panel illustrates the monthly trend, allowing stakeholders to observe seasonal patterns or significant spikes in giving throughout the year. Finally, the table panel lists the top 10 donors, recognizing the most generous contributors and providing a basis for gratitude and further engagement.
